messages:
lucy: [08:12] customer reported spikes of 429s on dedicated capacity during a traffic surge. They say the pool didn't scale. Attaching repro & logs.
ajay: checking, can you post the customer org id and a trace id?
lucy: org: oak-retailer-2, trace: f2d7a3c
customer: we saw ~18% failed requests over ~6m, latency up to 2s. no error before 08:10.
mike: can you paste the warm pool / min_replicas config for that org?
lucy: config snippet:
```yaml
deployments:
  oak-retailer-2:
    dedicated:
      min_replicas: 1
      max_replicas: 20
      warm_pool_size: 0
      probe_priority: default
```
jessie: ah that warm_pool_size==0 explains coldstart overhead. also infra logs show many attach timeouts + auth rotation 401s.
infra-bot: alert: attach_timeout spikes for cluster-gamma at 08:09-08:16 (rate 320/s)
lucy: sample logs:
```
[08:09:41] attach: pod create ok, imagePullBackOff
[08:09:49] attach: authz: token refresh failed: 401
[08:10:02] probe: failed to handshake: deadline exceeded
[08:10:18] autoscaler: evaluated, desired=18, currentReady=3, scaling_event delayed by probe_backoff
```
ajay: looks like a cascading effect: image pull backoffs + transient 401s from auth rotation cause probes to fail, autoscaler hesitates due to probe suppression (safety). we need repro steps.
lucy: repro steps I ran:
1) send sustained 150 rps to /generate for 7m with concurrent 25
2) trigger a rotating KMS key refresh on the org by hitting the key-rotate endpoint
3) observe attach timeouts & 429 spike

Command I used:
```bash
wrk -t4 -c25 -d420s --latency http://api.redwood.local/v1/generate
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.local/orgs/oak-retailer-2/rotate-keys
```
mike: can we triage whether autoscaler backoff policy is suppressing scale-up? jessie, any recent change to probe suppression logic?
jessie: we deployed a safetynet change last month that delays aggressive scaling when probe failures exceed threshold to avoid flapping. edge case: if warm_pool_size==0 and auth rotation causes probe failures, desired spikes don't materialize.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2024-5429 assigned to eng-runtime
ajay: mitigation suggestions:
- manually bump min_replicas to 4 for oak-retailer-2
- enable warm_pool_size: 3
- temporarily disable probe_suppression or shorten backoff window

Commands:
```bash
redwoodctl scale --org oak-retailer-2 --min 4
redwoodctl config set --org oak-retailer-2 warm_pool_size=3
redwoodctl autoscaler set --org oak-retailer-2 probe_suppression_window=30s
```
lucy: applied min_replicas=4 at 08:23. customer reports 429s dropping to <1% by 08:28. latency normalized.
customer: thanks, the service recovered after your change. we still saw ~2m of errors.
mike: root cause summary: combination of (1) warm_pool disabled, (2) auth token rotation causing transient 401s during pod attach, (3) autoscaler probe_suppression prevented aggressive scale-up. Follow-ups:
- add detection alert for 'probe failure + attach_timeout' correlation
- add a runbook step to increase warm_pool/min_replicas when key rotation is scheduled
- investigate improving imagePull retry/backoff telemetry

jessie: I'll add a short-term change to lower probe_suppression sensitivity for dedicated tiers by EOD.
ajay: I'll document repro & commands in the support ticket and add playbook.
lucy: closing loop with customer and scheduling postmortem with eng-runtime next week. :white_check_mark:
